method: Compared all recovered spans and seven free-translation blocks with original four-page specimens. Complete clauses cross physical lines; semicolons do not independently end utterances. Six dialogue labels are retained as provenance. No free translations invented for specimen I or for the constituent sentences within a larger translated block.
result: Approved for integration into unfrozen review proposal
integration_decisions: Retain utterance and translation-block evidence separately, even when a block consists of one utterance, because their analyses differ.
Keep concatenated interlinear English in the audit with its explicit type; never substitute it for a printed free translation.
Propagate all token transcription and grammatical uncertainties to the full expression audit and general uncertainty tag.
Preserve the seven standalone free-translation evidence units as contextual records, with no additional invented lexical emissions.
